title: PIXL 8000 Raspberry Watermelon Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Raspberry Watermelon PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod delivers a vibrant fusion of tangy Raspberry and fresh, delicately sweet Watermelon for a balanced fruit vape with real clarity. Each puff offers a crisp, uplifting burst of flavour that stays refreshing throughout. The 2ml pod contains 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid designed for smooth satisfaction and consistent vapour output. Compatible exclusively with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, it connects to a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically refills as you vape—offering up to 8000 puffs per kit with no spills or manual refilling. Mesh coil technology ensures clear, authentic flavour and a comfortable MTL draw.
